# Build How-To: Bloodstained Overeater Power Armor with Heavy Weapons (50 Caliber/Minigun)

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_207_nukaknights-post-build-bloodied-heavy-overeater-heavyguns.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

This build plays in **Power Armor** with **Heavy Ballistic Weapons**. Primarily **.50 caliber machine gun** and **minigun**. Preferably with **exploding bullets**. The power armor has the legendary main effect: "**The Glutton**" and thus offers good damage reduction. The “Stabilized” perk, which brings enormous advantages for heavy weapons, only works in PA.  The gameplay and weapons are **Bloodstained**, so low TP and high radiation (optimal: 20% TP, 80% radiation). He receives additional bonuses to weapon damage from bloodstained weapons, the Nerd Rage perk and the Adrenal Reaction mutation. The build is **also possible with full life** e.g. with Anti Armor, Double Shot, Mutant, Gourmet or Heavyweight weapons.

## Equipment

These 50 caliber MGs are the everyday equipment of this build. The Bloodstained for most situations with good damage and the Vampire for situations under heavy fire. The 50 cal has always been one of the most solid heavy weapons in Fallout 76. You can always rely on this heavy machine gun. It fires immediately (without delay like the minigun), has a good magazine size, is precise and efficient. The ideal heavy everyday weapon.

![BE90 Cal 50 (Bluestained, bullets explode, 90% reduced weight)](/uploads/nukaknights-build-bloodied-heavy-pa-mg-50cal-de.jpg) 

![VE Kal 50 (The Vampire, Bullets Explode)](/uploads/nukaknights-build-bloodied-heavy-pa-mg-ve50cal-de.jpg) 

The minigun also has a certain fun factor at times. However, the efficiency cannot be compared with the 50 caliber.

![BE Minigun (Bloodstained, Bullets Explode)](/uploads/nukaknights-build-bloodied-heavy-pa-mg-minigun-de.jpg) 

The pepper shaker is easy to play against smaller opponents, and at the same time is the best weapon to force the queen (firebeast queen) to land (cripple wings).

![Q2515 Pepper Shaker (Quadruple, 25% higher rate of fire, 15% faster reload speed)](/uploads/nukaknights-build-bloodied-heavy-pa-mg-peppershaker-de.jpg) 

Of course, other heavy weapons are playable with this build. Ideally, however, they should have exploding balls, as the skillset is designed for that and otherwise we would waste the potential of the perks. Additional alternative weapons include: Holy fire is suitable, and a chainsaw or automatic ax is also recommended for hardened opponents. For reflective enemies, a double-shot automatic grenade launcher is the best choice (e.g. the Nuka launcher).

## Power armor

Power armor offers more advantages in terms of perks for heavy weapons, so you are more precise and do more damage. As described in the post All Power Armors in Comparison, I recommend the **Union Armor** (+150 Poison Resistance & +75 Carrying Capacity / Season Reward or for Stamps at Guiseppe) for everyday life and the **Hellcat** Power Armor (+12% ballistic damage reduction / Reward: Steel Reign Quest) for intensive combat situations. Unfortunately, both cannot be traded.

So that you always have enough **fusion cores**, take a look at this article: Everything about fusion core farming & charging

**PA Set Wolverine Union**

Of course, this set isn't perfect either, as you can only roll legendary versions by making them yourself. A complete Wolverine set is important here, as a complete Wolverine set provides a **damage reduction of 30%**, which is better than higher damage resistances such as on the T-65.
